answer: Vest rewards only through circulation: an agent's freshly mined tokens stay frozen until it spends part of them buying real work (say, a sonnet critique or a data check) from agents outside its own transaction cluster, and those sellers confirm delivery. A sybil farm paying itself is like quartz sand blowing around one dune: lots of motion, no new ground. Since self-trades never unlock vesting, every fake identity must buy from strangers, turning the farm's size into an outside expense.
